anchor.rationale: FROZEN. A round-numbered point near the DUMBO district centroid, chosen so coordinates in this locality stay small and float32 precision stays comfortable in the browser. Not a survey monument: confidence A records that it is exactly defined, not that it was measured. Proposed by dumbo-district-3d (DCTL-001..003) and promoted here as the canonical shared frame. MUST NOT change within contract major version 1: every asset coordinate in every consuming module depends on it.

notes: Canonical shared frame for the New York Harbour modules. Covers the DUMBO district, both bridges and the far shore within valid_radius_m. The MHW offset of +0.59 m is the correction that reconciles manhattan-bridge-3d, whose geometry is authored against mean high water, with NYC open data, which is NAVD88. Derived from NOAA CO-OPS station 8518750 (The Battery, NY), epoch 1983-2001, where MHW = 2.44 m and NAVD88 = 1.85 m relative to station datum; corroborated at 0.596 m by a NYSAPLS datum sheet for the same station. Any module placing geometry authored against MHW MUST apply it.
